s1.text: Say a seller's toys sit on hold.

s2.text: Its certificate cites only the toy standard, part twelve-fifty.

s3.text: Painted? Usually add thirteen-oh-three. Under three? Fifteen-oh-one too.

s4.text: Say yours is painted, for toddlers. At least two are missing.

s5.text: Not sure which rules apply? Free CPSC finder, no account needed.
